description: Search the customer's connected CRM for people or companies by name, e-mail address or company name. Uses no lookup credit. Returns each record's id and a link to it in the CRM.

kind.description: what to search: people (the default) or companies

query.description: what to search for: part of a name, an e-mail address or a company name

name: search_crm

has_more.description: true when another page of results exists

company_match.description: for a possible match: whether the record's company agrees with the one given

email_conflict.description: true when the record holds an e-mail address that none of the person's known addresses matches, which argues against it being the same person

entity_type.description: contact or lead, in CRMs that have both

match.description: profile_link, email or confirmed for a certain match; name for a possible one

profile_url.description: the public profile link the record holds, when it holds one

record_id.description: the record's id in the CRM; pass it to get_crm_record, update_crm_record or log_crm_activity

url.description: link to the record in the CRM; share it with the customer

title: Search the CRM
